newsitem.title: USA: Penril Q4 oper rev $13.1 mln vs $13.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Penril Q4 oper rev $13.1 mln vs $13.7 mln.

text.p: Pentril DataComm Networks Inc said on Wednesday it had operating revenues of $13.1 million in the quarter, versus revenues of $13.7 million in the same quarter last year.

The advanced modem, WAN and internetworking products provider said it took a $9.7 million charge in the fourth quarter, in anticipation of the previously announced spinoff of its networking products business.
After the charge, the company said its net loss in the quarter was $11.9 million.
Penril was not immediately available to comment on the decline in its operating revenues.
The company said results did not include the perfomance of Penril's Electro-Metrics Inc unit, which was classified as a discontinued business in anticipation of its sale later in 1996.
For the fiscal year 1996, Penril said it had total revenues from continuing business of $39.4 million versus $52.6 million in fiscal 1995.
Net loss for the year was $19.9 million, including the $9.7 million restructuring costs, compared to a net loss of $3.8 million in fiscal 1995.
The company said the write-off was consistent with spinoff plans.
Penril plans to spin-off its networking products to shareholders, forming a new company called Access Beyond Inc. Its remaining modem business would be sold to Bay Networks Inc in a tax free merger.
